items.title: Interface Metaphor
items.desc: Each prefab establishes an Interface Metaphor that unites its signifiers and mappings. List each prefab by its metaphor and signifiers, and each affordance with the signifiers that communicate it and how they connect to the metaphor. Graded 0-4 on how well this holds.

items.title: Building Affordance
items.desc: Through an interaction, the player can spawn Instances (referred to as Buildings) at locations they specify, perhaps in exchange for a Resource.

items.title: Gridded Buildings
items.desc: Requires Building Affordance. Built positions snap to a regular grid.

items.title: Statted Instances: Prefab Content
items.desc: Prefabs scripted with Stats that change through interactions or time, with a visual indication of the Stats. Each counted prefab has at least three Affordances or Spatial Dynamics affecting it. List each prefab by name. 3 prefabs = 1 pt, 5 = 2 pts, 8 = 3 pts, 13 = 4 pts.

items.title: Statted Instances: Stat Content
items.desc: Total count of distinctly named Stats across all prefabs. List each Stat by name. 3 Stats = 1 pt, 5 = 2 pts, 8 = 3 pts, 13 = 4 pts, 21 = 5 pts.

items.title: Passive Stat Gain
items.desc: A prefab uses Euler Integration so its Instances passively advance a Stat over time.

items.title: Player Resource
items.desc: The player has Resources that change with events or time. Count of Resources visible in the video. 3 Resources = 1 pt, 5 = 2 pts, 8 = 3 pts, 13 = 4 pts, 21 = 5 pts, 34 = 6 pts.

items.title: Wild Instances
items.desc: Some Instances are generated randomly in the space when the game starts.

items.title: Texture Animation Signifiers
items.desc: UV mapping is used to animate an object to signify its dynamics.

items.title: Pop-up Tutorials
items.desc: When a player first encounters a new affordance or spatial dynamic, a textual signifier pops up next to the mechanic's object explaining it. 3 pop-ups = 1 pt, 5 = 2 pts, 8 = 3 pts, 13 = 4 pts, 21 = 5 pts.

items.title: Harvesting Affordance
items.desc: Through a player interaction, the player gathers a class of Instances (Destroying it or reducing one of its Stats) in exchange for increasing a player Resource.

items.title: Caretaking Affordance
items.desc: Through a player interaction, the player boosts an Instance's Stats, optionally in exchange for decreasing a Resource or just freely from their effort.

items.title: Shatter Affordance
items.desc: Requires Harvesting Affordance. Through a player interaction, the player replaces one Instance with a different Instance that can be harvested.

items.title: Crafting Affordance Content
items.desc: Through player interactions, the player exchanges a decrease in some Resources for an increase in others. Count of exchange interactions available. 2 recipes = 1 pt, 3 = 2 pts, 5 = 3 pts, 8 = 4 pts, 13 = 5 pts, 21 = 6 pts.

items.title: Collisions
items.desc: A prefab has a script triggered when Instances of particular prefabs collide with it: one Instance is Destroyed and the other has its Stats changed. 1 collision script = 1 pt, 3 = 2 pts, 5 = 3 pts, 8 = 4 pts, 13 = 5 pts.

items.title: Neighbor Interactions
items.desc: Extends Gridded Buildings and Passive Stat Gain. Instances on neighboring grid positions have regularly recurring interactions that change both of their Stats. Cannot also count as a Collision Interaction. 1 interacting pair = 1 pt, 3 = 2 pts, 5 = 3 pts, 8 = 4 pts, 13 = 5 pts, 21 = 6 pts.

items.title: Foundation Buildings
items.desc: Building an Instance of one prefab at a location first requires an Instance of a different prefab to already be built there.

items.title: Death
items.desc: A Stat on certain Instances, when it drops to zero, causes that Instance to be Destroyed.

items.title: Intermittent Instances
items.desc: Requires Wild Instances. Some Instances are generated at random times during the game.

items.title: Path Following
items.desc: An Instance follows a designer-defined path other than a straight line, thats pre-defined by the designer.

items.title: Built Paths
items.desc: Extends Path Following and Gridded Buildings. The player builds pathway buildings on the grid, and other Instances flow down these "pathway" buildings.

items.title: Path Planning
items.desc: Requires Path Following. The Instance's path is dynamically planned around buildings using a planning algorithm.

items.title: Planning down Pathways
items.desc: Requires Built Paths and Path Planning. The path is planned only along pathway buildings.

items.title: Population Resource with Pathing
items.desc: Requires Path Planning. A population of Instances represents a player Resource: more are spawned as the Resource is gained. When the player consumes that resource, the instances path themselves to the point of use and despawn.

items.title: Solar Coaster
items.desc: Motion is simulated along a mesh strip by an increasing offset on the texture's UV coordinates of the texture map that increases over time.

items.title: Solar Blast
items.desc: Requires Solar Coaster. A blast effect is animated by scrolling UV coordinates over a circular mesh.

items.title: UV Distortion
items.desc: Wiggling, flapping, or blobby jiggling is animated on a texture by scrolling a second noise texture and using the noise to displace the UV coordinates of the first texture
